# Licences of the clips

Two clips of this folder copy an extract of a third-party page. Each keeps the licence of its source, as the
README lists them ([Contenus de tiers](../../../README.md#contenus-de-tiers)).

- `page_with_a_rule_in_its_text.md`: an extract of
  [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/), W3C Recommendation of
  12 December 2024. Copyright © 2020-2024 World Wide Web Consortium. Under the
  [W3C Document License](https://www.w3.org/copyright/document-license/).
- `page_without_author_or_date.md`: an extract of a page of the OWASP website
  ([source](https://owasp.github.io/www-project-agentic-skills-top-10/videos/?video=ast01)), © OWASP, under
  [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

`article_with_author.md` keeps the form of a clip of a Medium article; its title, text, author and URL are
written for the tests.
